mentions.name: Multiplayer tactical shooter (Godot)
mentions.description: A multiplayer tactical shooter inspired by the id tech 3 era, built with Godot. Movement sits between Counter-Strike and Quake (more mobility than CS, less than Quake), and the game centers on an infiltration mode where one team steals a briefcase back to base while the other team defends.
